collection.title: Ford Ranger 2011 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Ranger 2011 to 2015 model requires a 24" wiper blade for the drivers and a 16"  for the passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper.
